matrix_policy.order: A, B, C, D, E, F, frozen
matrix_policy.all_six_cells_continue_after_a_behaviour: a behavioural FAIL in any cell is PRESERVED and the remaining cells STILL RUN
matrix_policy.only_a_technical_or_integrity_exception_: and it fails closed, committing nothing
matrix_policy.aggregate_pass_iff: 6/6 cells behavioural PASS AND 6/6 cells telemetry-valid

behavioural_fail.expected_state: the leaf IS COMMITTED atomically with the full per-cell evidence and verdict FAIL; the process exits non-zero
behavioural_fail.action: PRESERVE the committed evidence. STOP and diagnose. No retry.

technical_or_integrity_error.expected_state: NO leaf is committed; the staging and lock this run created are removed; content it did not create survives
technical_or_integrity_error.action: STOP and diagnose. No retry, no second attempt.

pass.expected_state: the leaf is committed with verdict PASS; the process exits 0
pass.action: PRESERVE the evidence, write the user report, and hand back to the architect for independent audit
pass.confers_nothing: authorises no critic, no PPO, no promotion and no next stage
